author: AyyJake
body:
So I don't know if this has been suggested before but the point is at the end of each game there will be stuff like "Player with most kills" I don't know how this would work in the game but I thought it would be cool.

List of ideas
  • Most Kills
  • Most Kills With A Bow
  • Most Kills With A Sword
  • First Blood
  • Last Blood
  • Longest Kill With A Bow
  • Shortest Kill With A Bow
  • Most Objectives
  • Highest K/D

That's all we have so far
